snippet.title: Abyss: New Dawn – Official Trailer [Early Access | August 22, 2025]
snippet.description:
Abyss: New Dawn is a multiplayer adventure–survival RPG where farming, crafting, hunting, and combat all converge deep beneath a fractured world.

⚔️ Build your home. 🧬 Customize your character. 🌱 Grow your crops. 🔥 Face the Goblin King guarding the Abyssial Gate.  
What lies beyond… may not let you return.
DEMO OUT NOW!
👉https://store.steampowered.com/app/3173630/Abyss_New_Dawn_Demo/

🗓️ Early Access: August 22, 2025  
📌 Add to your Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747280/Abyss_New_Dawn/

🌐 Official Website: https://www.abyssnewdawn.com  
🎮 Follow us on Twitter: https://x.com/Abyss_NewDawn
